title: Design System: Tatarverse
summary: Bilingual cultural-center catalog with a controlled homepage brand layer and a quiet neutral catalog layer, themed by a user-chosen accent across light and dark. The shipped default accent is monochrome ink, not a hue.

layers.name: Brand layer
layers.purpose: Homepage identity moments: flower mark, rotating news badge, heavy uppercase hero with one accent line, and the feature-section stack (statement, search screenshot, link showcase, people numbers).

layers.name: Catalog layer
layers.purpose: Centers list, detail pages, saved, nearby, stats, MDX content, filters, search, navigation, translation surfaces, and source-backed factual content.

layers.name: Appearance layer
layers.purpose: User-controlled presentation: theme (system/light/dark), accent preset (default/green/blue/violet/red/orange/pink), and a motion on/off toggle. Applied as `.dark`, `[data-accent]`, and `[data-motion]` on <html> by an inline script in Layout.astro <head> before first paint.

rules: Never hardcode a hue. Ship only `--color-*` tokens (`accent`, `accent-vivid`, `accent-glow`, `foreground`, `surface`, `border`, `depth-*`), so a surface survives all seven accent presets in both themes.
The accent is a signal — hero line, focus ring, active state — not a general palette. Neutrals carry the catalog.

Every new color is authored twice: a light value in `@theme` in src/styles/tailwind.css and a dark value in src/styles/palettes/<preset>.css. Contrast floors: >=4.5:1 for small UI, >=3:1 for display type. Check the pairs against the CSS itself after touching a palette — the standalone audit script was removed as a second source of truth.
Use real interface imagery when explaining product behavior.
Preserve locale routes, source links, stable slugs, and factual copy.

Every animated component needs two escape paths, not one: `prefers-reduced-motion` and the user toggle `[data-motion="off"]`. The toggle kills animation and transition globally, so never rely on `transitionend`/`animationend` firing without an explicit 1ms carve-out.
Every number on a public surface is computed from the collections or carries a visible source. HomePeopleStats currently violates this and is marked as debt.
Check a visual change in the monochrome `default` preset first: it is what ships, and a change that only reads under a colored preset does not read.

colorMeta.source: src/styles/tailwind.css несёт светлые нейтрали в @theme и тёмные в .dark; src/styles/palettes/<name>.css — только акцентные токены пресета в обеих темах. Ни один пресет не переопределяет нейтрали, границы, глубину или радиусы: бумага одна на все семь. `canonical` ниже — светлое значение, `dark` — значение из блока .dark в tailwind.css, которое работает и как фолбэк, пока data-accent не проставлен.

background.usage: Плоскость страницы. Больше не равна surface: в светлой теме страница слегка тонирована (97.5%), карточка остаётся белой.

foreground.usage: Primary text, high hierarchy, strong links, and active catalog states.

muted.usage: Полоса секции и тихие заливки. Лежит МЕЖДУ background и surface: полоса утоплена относительно страницы, карточка на ней приподнята.

subtleForeground.usage: Самый тусклый текстовый токен. Проходит 4.55:1 против всех пяти заливок своей палитры, а не только против страницы.

surface.usage: Карточки, панели, поповеры. Верхняя ступень лестницы поверхностей.

border.usage: Выводится, а не пишется по палитрам: всегда на фиксированной перцептивной дистанции от своей поверхности. Рукописное значение уезжало — border-muted давал 1.10:1 на surface у red и pink.

primary.usage: Primary actions, active filters, and strongest text. Inverts with the theme — pair with `primary-foreground`, never with a literal white or black.

default.note: Монохром: акцент здесь — сами чернила, поэтому тема разворачивает картинку целиком.

accent.source: The preset list itself lives in src/utils/accents.ts — one array feeding both the header dropdown and the mobile toggle. Never copy the swatch array into a component.
accent.usage: Focus rings, active states, and the homepage hero word. Монохромный `default` — дефолтный пресет. Held at >=4.5:1 on its own background in every preset/theme pair. The CSS is the check, not this note: read the authored values out of src/styles/tailwind.css and src/styles/palettes/*.css rather than trusting a written-down number. Fourteen theme × preset pairs matter — accent on its background, accent-foreground on accent, vivid at display scale, the accent-soft pair, subtle-foreground on bg-subtle, and the page→surface lightness step.

accentVivid.usage: Display-scale type only (hero lines), where WCAG allows 3:1. Never on small UI.

accentGlow.usage: Source tone for the hero `drop-shadow` halo (`--animate-hero-pulse`). Decorative only, never load-bearing for text contrast.

shade.usage: Shadows, and effectively light-theme only. Black in both themes — vary opacity, not lightness. Never derive a shadow from `foreground`: it goes near-white in dark and the shadow glows. In dark, depth comes from the lightness step and from `lift`, not from this token — black on near-black draws nothing.

lift.usage: Counterpart to `shade`: the inset top-edge highlight on floating panels. White in both themes, but only load-bearing in dark, where it replaces the shadow. Used by the `overlay-lift` utility.

depth.usage: Ступени тональной глубины. depth-100 — тихая линия: разделители секций, кольца MDX-панелей, пагинация. Выводится так, чтобы читаться и на surface, и на muted; альфа-модификатор на нём запрещён. Кольца у карточки каталога больше нет — на сетке в четыре сотни карточек оно читалось рябью.

display.purpose: Heavy uppercase homepage hero lines only.
display.fontFamily: 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

headline.purpose: Major page titles and high-level catalog surfaces.
headline.fontFamily: 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

body.purpose: Readable factual content, MDX prose, center summaries, and supporting copy.
body.fontFamily: 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

label.purpose: Compact controls, chips, metadata, stats labels, and navigation.
label.fontFamily: 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

shape.scale: Four semantic steps, used as Tailwind utilities. Never write a raw rounded-2xl/3xl/4xl — those are the default preset's numbers, not the meaning.
shape.micro: rounded-micro — 8px — badges, chips, inputs, small icon buttons
shape.control: rounded-control — 16px — buttons, menu items, toolbars, popovers
shape.card: rounded-card — 24px — panels, sections, ordinary cards, marketing blocks
shape.catalog: rounded-catalog — 32px — center cards and other large catalog surfaces
shape.full: rounded-full stays raw: a pill is not a step on the scale and must not move with the preset, or toggles and avatars stop being circles
shape.followsAccent: No. Radius is a constant of the system, not part of the preset: one scale 8/16/24/32 in @theme serves all seven presets in both themes. Palette files declare no --radius-* at all. The three former shape registers (default 8/16/24/32, medium 8/12/18/24, small 6/8/12/16) were removed — picking a colour must not silently rebuild the geometry of every card and button. Contrast depends on the background, shape does not.
shape.exceptions: src/pages/centers/print.astro keeps raw radii — paper must not shift with a screen preset.

shadows.name: soft-surface-lift
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for cards, controls, MDX panels, and menu surfaces.

shadows.name: surface-lift
shadows.purpose: In-flow raised surfaces: cards and screenshot-led feature sections. Soft shadow in light, no shadow in dark — there the background→surface lightness step and the ring carry the separation.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating panels: menus, popovers, suggestion lists. Soft shadow in light, a 1px inset top highlight in dark. Pair it with `bg-surface`, never `bg-background` — on the page tone the panel has nothing but its border.

motion.name: hero-pulse
motion.purpose: Accent-tinted drop-shadow halo breathing around the hero accent line, sourced from --color-accent-glow.

motion.name: hero-gray-drift
motion.purpose: Quiet background-position drift available to hero lines.

motion.name: hero-badge-in
motion.purpose: Hero news badge card entrance. Rotation itself is timer-driven, never transitionend-driven.

motion.name: drawer-in / drawer-out
motion.purpose: Mobile drawer and its backdrop, with fade-in/fade-out on the backdrop. Asymmetric curves, so these are animations rather than transitions.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Small hover, focus, and active-state feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animated components must provide a reduced-motion path via `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.

motion.name: motion-toggle
motion.purpose: Second, independent off switch: `[data-motion="off"]` on <html> kills animation and transition outright. Anything waiting on animationend/transitionend must be carved out with animation-duration: 1ms — see [data-menu-list] / [data-menu-backdrop].

motion.name: no-js-animation-library
motion.purpose: All motion is CSS in src/styles/tailwind.css or a component <style> block. There is no JS animation library in the project.

surfaceLadder.rule: muted лежит между background и surface. Полоса секции утоплена относительно страницы, карточка на полосе приподнята. Обратный порядок схлопывает каталог.

dark.note: Одна тёмная лестница на все семь пресетов — бывший регистр violet (Vercel): чистый чёрный холст, скупо приподнятые поверхности, тихие границы, чернила 93%, а не белые. Персональных лестниц у пресетов больше нет: палитра меняет только акцент.

surfaceLadder.constraints: Значения решены численно: порядок лестницы, карточка-на-полосе >= ΔL 4, border-muted >= 1.28:1 к surface и background, border >= 1.5:1, muted-foreground и subtle-foreground >= 4.55:1 против всех пяти заливок общей лестницы.

derivedSteps.rationale: Приём HeroUI v3: ступень вычисляется как подмешивание собственной подложки к её же чернилам. Отказ вида «граница стала невидимой» становится структурно невозможным. Проценты решены под наши пороги — у HeroUI 78%/92% дают ΔL 2.6-3.7 там, где нам нужно 4.
derivedSteps.authored: background, muted, surface и subtle авторские, но единые на все семь пресетов (тёмная лестница 0/2/5/14 — бывший регистр violet); surface-muted и оба border выводятся из surface.
derivedSteps.verified: Худшие случаи в браузере по 14 комбинациям: border-muted 1.28, border 1.51, depth-100 на surface 1.35, на полосе 1.23, ΔL surface-muted 3.4.

components.name: Logo Mark
components.description: flower.svg used as a CSS mask and filled with a flat --color-accent. Static: no gradient, no shimmer animation. Accent is the only thing that changes it.

components.name: Hero Title
components.description: Heavy uppercase localized hero lines with one accent-tinted phrase and quieter secondary lines. The accent tone follows the user's preset and theme.
components.html: Catalog phrase
components.css: .hero-title { font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; text-wrap: balance; } .hero-title__accent { color: var(--color-accent-vivid); }

components.name: Catalog Stats
components.description: Three compact stat pills with icons, tabular numbers, muted labels, and a brief focus animation.
components.html:

Centers

components.name: Search Screenshot Section
components.description: Localized product-image section using real search screenshots beside concise explanatory copy.
components.html:
Search title

Search copy
components.css: .search-feature { overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-card, 24px); background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-shade) 10%, transparent); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action for clear navigation or active commands.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #ffffff); padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/1.25 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet navigation action used in header and mobile menu links.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/1.25 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d) 5%, transparent); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact filter control with a clear active state.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; max-width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: var(--color-muted, #f0f0f0); color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); padding: 6px 10px; font: 500 14px/1.25 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-filter-chip[data-active='true'] { background: var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #ffffff); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Primary catalog search field with soft ring and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-search input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-surface-foreground, #1d1d1d); padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 14px/1.25 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-depth-100, #e6e6e6); outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-subtle-foreground, #8f8f8f); } .ds-search input:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Center Card
components.description: Signature catalog list item for center pages. It keeps title, type, category, location, and summary readable in a quiet neutral surface.
components.css: .ds-center-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-catalog, 32px); background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-surface-foreground, #1d1d1d); padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-depth-100, #d6d6d6); } .ds-center-card h3 { overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--color-surface-foreground, #1d1d1d); font: 700 16px/1.375 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; }

components.name: MDX Surface
components.description: Readable factual prose surface with typography tokens, restrained border, and quiet lift.
components.html: <article class="prose rounded-control border border-border-muted bg-surface p-8 shadow-2xs ring ring-depth-100">Content</article>

narrative.overview: Tatarverse pairs a memorable homepage identity with a quiet, practical catalog. The homepage may use the flower mark, heavy uppercase hero type with one accent line, a data-derived news badge, and feature sections built on real imagery and computed counts. Catalog surfaces remain neutral, factual, and easy to scan. Presentation is the visitor's: seven accent presets (monochrome `default` ships), light/dark/system, and a motion toggle, so no surface may assume one fixed hue or one fixed theme.
keyCharacteristics: Two-layer system: homepage brand layer plus catalog utility layer.
Neutral semantic tokens carry structure; one light ladder and one dark ladder serve all seven presets.
A preset is colour and nothing but colour — no per-preset neutrals, radii, or shadows.
The user-chosen accent stays a signal: hero line, focus ring, active state. The default one is monochrome.
Squircle geometry on one four-step radius scale for controls, cards, sections, and catalog primitives.
Homepage feature sections are unframed: real imagery and computed counts on the bare page, no stacked full-width cards.
Motion limited to the hero, the badge, the drawer, and small control feedback — CSS only.

rules.name: Neutrals Carry Structure
rules.body: Default to semantic neutral tokens for layout, controls, content, and catalog surfaces.

rules.name: The Accent Is A Signal
rules.body: The accent belongs to the homepage identity moment, focus, and active state only — and it is whichever preset the visitor picked, so it is only ever referenced as `var(--color-accent)` / `accent-vivid` / `accent-glow`. Links are not accent-coloured: prose links use `link` / `link-decoration`.

rules.name: The Surface Ladder Is Load-Bearing
rules.body: `muted` sits between `background` and `surface`. A band is recessed, a card on it is raised. Reversing the order collapses the catalog.

rules.name: Radius Is A Constant
rules.body: One scale 8/16/24/32 in @theme for all seven presets. Never a raw rounded-2xl/3xl/4xl; `rounded-full` stays raw.

rules.name: Display Is Scarce
rules.body: Heavy uppercase display type is for homepage identity and rare page-level statements. The hero clamp is measured per locale — re-measure when the copy changes.

rules.name: Cards Are Functional
rules.body: Use cards for center records, posts, MDX surfaces, and real grouped data. One ring per nesting level; the save button is the only control allowed on top of a card link.

rules.name: Every Number Is Computed
rules.body: Public counts come from the collections or from the same parser the card uses. A figure without a source does not ship.

rules.name: Motion Must Have A Reason
rules.body: Motion is allowed for identity, the drawer, and small state feedback, and must survive both off switches: OS reduced-motion and the header `[data-motion="off"]` toggle.

dos: Reuse src/styles/tailwind.css tokens before adding visual roles.
Keep the homepage brand layer distinct from catalog utility surfaces.
Use real product imagery where it clarifies a feature.
Preserve source-backed content, locale routes, stable slugs, and metadata behavior.
Verify contrast for muted labels, placeholders, metadata, and small controls against every fill they sit on, not just the page.
Keep both motion escape paths in every animated component: `prefers-reduced-motion` and `[data-motion="off"]`.
Author every new color twice — light in `@theme`, dark under `.dark` — and check it in the monochrome default before any hue.
donts: Do not turn the whole site into the accent hue, and never hardcode one — the visitor can switch it to any of six hues or back to monochrome at any moment.
Do not hardcode hex or Tailwind palette classes; the platform tiles in the link showcase and the social buttons are the only sanctioned brand-mark exception.
Do not give a preset its own neutrals, radii, or shadows.
Do not add extra cultural palettes or ornamental motifs.
Do not add glossy SaaS gradients, glass panels, side stripes, or generic icon-card grids.
Do not reuse homepage display treatment inside dense catalog surfaces.
Do not add decorative motion to MDX pages, lists, or center detail content.
Do not rewrite factual copy into slogans, and do not ship an unsourced number.
Do not wrap the homepage feature sections back into full-width cards — spacing carries them; only their images are rounded.
